files.proposal.md:
# Fieldline Proposal

## Overview
Fieldline schedules field technicians and tracks parts across sites.

## Hosting
Fieldline runs as SaaS in EU regions. An on-prem edition runs on customer hardware with the same features and quarterly updates.

## SaaS pricing
EUR 18 per technician per month, billed annually.

## Support
Business-hours support with a 4-hour response target.
